product_information.title: Indication
product_information.value: Ceplene maintenance therapy is Indicated for adult patients with acute myeloid leukaemia (AML) in first remission concomitantly treated with interleukin-2 (IL-2). The efficacy of Ceplene has not been fully demonstrated in patients older than age 60.
